title: Batch-cache fallback advisor and quant-profile heuristics
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: We observe periodic QoS regressions when tenant-specific batch caching config falls back too eagerly to compact quantized models during capacity pressure. This PR introduces a decision-layer (BatchCacheFallbackAdvisor) that uses short-window telemetry and a conservative unit-econ score to recommend safe fallback actions and quantization tiers per-tenant.

Summary of changes: introduces a lightweight advisor library, a CLI dry-run mode, a telemetry gating flag, and a small set of heuristics to avoid aggressive fallback that increases latency or harms output quality. This is intended as an intermediate safety net while we iterate on the full policy compiler.

What it does (high level):
- Adds pkg/econ/advisor: decision logic that computes a fallback recommendation for batch-cache eviction and quantization tier selection given recent latency, error-rate, and token-cost signals.
- Provides a tenant-scoped scoring function that balances unit-econ (tokens/second cost) and latency SLO risk.
- Exposes a new CLI: econctl suggest --tenant <id> --dry-run that returns recommended actions without applying them.
- Adds a telemetry gating toggle (enabled by default for canary) that prevents rollout unless we see stable metrics for 30m.
- Adds end-to-end smoke tests and a deterministic simulator for reviewer replay.

Checklist: [x] design doc linked inline, [x] unit tests added, [x] e2e smoke added, [x] docs updated, [x] telemetry dashboards updated, [x] canary gating enabled by default.

Backward compat: No changes to public API. The advisor is opt-in for existing tenant policies; the default behavior for tenants without explicit use remains unchanged. The CLI is purely additive.

Rollout plan: Merge to main, enable canary for 10% of tenants for 48h, monitor the prefilling/latency dashboards and the unit-econ score. If regressions appear, the advisor can be disabled with econ.advisor.enabled=false at runtime and queued for hotfix.

Related: ENG-4921 (safety gating), ENG-5012 (unit-econ telemetry).

release_notes: Introduce a conservative BatchCacheFallbackAdvisor to provide tenant-scoped safe fallback recommendations and quant-tier heuristics; adds econctl dry-run; telemetry gating and advisor decision metrics for auditing. Rollout is canary-gated.
notes_for_oncall: If tenant latency SLOs spike after rollout, toggle econ.advisor.enabled=false and open an incident with ENG-4921 tagged. Advisor emits advisor.decision_reason telemetry; use prefilling and unit-econ dashboards to troubleshoot.
